messages:
oliver: started canary rollout v4.4 to us-west ~4m ago. quick health-checks passed but smokebot shows intermittent 503s on /v1/embed.

deploy-bot: Deploy v4.4 -> canaries deployed (6/6). tag: v4.4.0.

smokebot: synthetic probe -> /v1/embed had 3 failures of 7 samples; failures concentrated on usw-can-06. p95 ~2.2x baseline.

rita: looking at host metrics: usw-can-06 kv_prefill_backlog=11, prefill_workers=1. proxy logs show upstream timeout for shard=9.

oliver: running focused probe against usw-can-06 now: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://usw-can-06.api.redwood/v1/embed -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -d '{"input":"smoke"}' -w "\n%{http_code} %{time_total}\n"
```

oliver: samples -> 200 0.18, 503 0.29, 200 0.17 (intermittent).

infra-bot: host snapshot: kv_prefill_backlog=11 workers=1 prefill_errors=0.

rita: hypothesis: prefill queue starved due to low worker concurrency on new canary. plan: trigger targeted prefill with concurrency=4 and rerun the synth. recommend holding rollforward for 15m and pin canaries for 12h. add ops note: if issue recurs, run hotpatch to increase prefill_workers on affected hosts during startup.

oliver: executing prefill task now -> output: "queued 5 prefixes -> concurrency=4 -> processed 5 -> completed in 13s".

smokebot: rerun synthetic -> /v1/embed 7/7 success from usw-can-06. p50/p95 back to baseline.

rita: decision: resume rollforward with 15m observation; enable alerts for embed p99 and kv_prefill_backlog>6 for 12h. i'll draft internal release note: "v4.4.0 - gradual rollout. Transient kv prefill backlog observed on canary usw-can-06 causing intermittent 503s to /v1/embed; mitigation: targeted prefill with increased concurrency; rollforward resumed; alerts enabled; playbook updated."

oliver: creating follow-up ticket INFRA-7244 to add startup prefill progress metric and allow configurable worker concurrency via deploy config.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollforward to remainder of us-west in 15m from 6177777837.

rita: oncall checklist: 1) verify embed p99 returns to baseline 2) confirm prefill drain on newly added hosts 3) abort and pin if error rate >4% over 5m.

oliver: i'll monitor for the next hour. thanks team.

smokebot: reaction :white_check_mark:.
